titleStmt.title: French Proposals Regarding a Treaty of Regional Assistance To Be Signed by Poland, Russia, Germany, Czechoslovakia, Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania

head.hi: French Proposals Regarding a Treaty of Regional Assistance To Be Signed by Poland, Russia, Germany, Czechoslovakia, Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania

div.p: 1.Treaty of Regional Assistance to be signed by Poland, Russia, Germany, Czechoslovakia, Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania

list.label: (a)
list.item: These countries would bind themselves in conformity with Covenant immediately to lend assistance to one another in the case of attack by one contracting state on another.
list.label: (b)
list.item: No support would be given by any of signatories to an aggressor country not a party to treaty.

list.label: (a)
list.item: In the case of attack or threatened attack by a contracting country, the other parties would consult together with a view to avoidance of a conflict and in order to promote a return to peace.
list.label: (b)
list.item: The signatories would undertake the same commitment in the case of attack or of threatened attack by a Power which is not a signatory against a signatory Power.
list.label: (c)
list.item: The consultations referred to in paragraphs (a) and (b) of Part II could extend to other interested Powers or to Powers entitled to participate in them by virtue of other treaties.
list.label: (d)
list.item:
Where one contracting country could benefit from provisions of Article 10 and Article 16 of Covenant of League, the other signatories
would undertake to secure a complete application of such provisions by League of Nations.

list.label: (a)
list.item: As towards France, Russia would accept obligations arising from Treaty of Locarno as though Soviet Union were a signatory of that treaty on same footing as Great Britain or Italy.
list.label: (b)
list.item: As towards Russia, France would accept Commitments which would arise for her under Part I, paragraphs (a) and (b), of Regional Treaty if she were a signatory, in cases where it is a question of action in fulfilment of Article 16 of Covenant or decisive action taken by Assembly or Council or in fulfilment of paragraph 7 of Article 15 of Covenant.
list.label: (c)
list.item: France would be invited if case arose to participate in consultations provided for in Treaty of Regional Assistance under terms of Article (a) of Part II.

div.p: 3. A General Act, Signatories: All States signatories of Treaty of Regional Assistance and in addition France

list.label: (a)
list.item: The two preceding treaties are recognized as being of a character to contribute to maintenance of peace.
list.label: (b)
list.item: They are without prejudice to obligations and rights of contracting parties as members of League of Nations.
list.label: (c)
list.item: Entry into force of three acts is subject to their ratification and to entry into League of Nations of Russia.
